all.source_quote: Indian citizens between 14-35 years (depending on trade)

unmodelled.text: Must have studied at least up to Class V
unmodelled.source_quote: Must have minimum educational qualification (Class V)

unmodelled.text: Must not have done an apprenticeship in the same trade before
unmodelled.source_quote: Not previously undergone apprenticeship in the same trade

unmodelled.text: The employer must be registered under the Apprenticeship Act
unmodelled.source_quote: Industries/employers must be registered under Apprenticeship Act

ambiguous: Source is a short summary by the Department of Information & Cultural Affairs on wb.gov.in, not the scheme's own guidelines
The age range depends on the trade; 14 to 35 is the widest range the page states
Class V is a past qualification, while education_level is the class being studied now, so it is not modelled

en.title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
en.benefit: Paid apprenticeship with on-the-job training and a certificate; the government shares the stipend with the employer.
en.how_to_apply: Register on the Apprenticeship Portal, choose a trade and employer, and apply.
